name: forum: a paired collection split into forward and reverse lists
description: From help.galaxyproject.org (2026, 'Split paired reads into forward and reverse collections'): a tool downstream wants the mates as two lists. The history already holds a list:paired collection. Galaxy's own Unzip collection tool does this in one step and records it; building two lists through the API leaves no step in the history. Graded on the two lists Galaxy holds, their identifiers, and that a tool produced them.
inputs: The collection "reads" in my current history is paired-end. The next tool I use needs the forward reads and the reverse reads as two separate collections. Please make those two collections.
